notes: Item 19 discloses gross sales for 107 franchised Covered Businesses for the full 2025 calendar year. Summary statistics (average, median, min, max) are provided at the cohort level. Note 10 in the document states the average is computed by dividing by 110, which is inconsistent with the 107 Covered Businesses listed — this discrepancy appears in the source document itself and may reflect three additional businesses reported elsewhere or a drafting error. Individual outlet-level gross sales are disclosed for Franchises 1 through 107. No profit, EBITDA, or other financial metrics are disclosed. Only gross sales are represented.
